calculation.description: Fades each instrument's three-session return, risk-normalized by 15-session volatility, with stronger reversal exposure when instrument range expansion and the observation-only VIX percentile indicate stress. VIX is used solely as a macro conditioning input and is not tradable. All inputs are lagged completed daily observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.051644, ICIR 0.161115, 607 dates), 2023-2024 (0.015701, ICIR 0.046767, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.035569, ICIR 0.107986, 491 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
